description: This Java class JwtTokenFactory is responsible for creating, parsing, and managing JWT tokens for security/authentication purposes within the Thingsboard platform. It handles access tokens, refresh tokens, and MFA tokens, utilizing external JWT libraries and project-specific security models.

classes.name: JwtTokenFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating, parsing, and managing JWT tokens for user authentication and authorization.

methods.name: createAccessJwtToken
methods.description: Creates a new access JWT token for a given SecurityUser.

methods.name: parseAccessJwtToken
methods.description: Parses a given access JWT token string into a SecurityUser object.

methods.name: createRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates a refresh JWT token for a SecurityUser.

methods.name: parseRefreshToken
methods.description: Parses a refresh token string into a SecurityUser object.

methods.name: createMfaToken
methods.description: Creates an MFA JWT token with specified scope and expiration.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the secret key and JWT parser configurations.

methods.name: setUpToken
methods.description: Sets up a JWT token builder with claims based on the SecurityUser and scopes.

methods.name: parseTokenClaims
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token string, returning claims or throwing exceptions.

methods.name: createTokenPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of access and refresh tokens for a SecurityUser.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Retrieves or reloads the secret key used for signing JWTs.

methods.name: getJwtParser
methods.description: Retrieves or reloads the JWT parser instance.
